subject: SF Stage Stewardship: action checklist for stale opportunities
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: SF Stage Stewardship: action checklist for stale opportunities

Team —

Quick one this morning: finance flagged a cluster of opportunities tied to Brightline (see attached extract) that have not had a stage or close-date update in >45 days. We need a lightweight stewardship sweep so the forecast for next quarter is accurate.

What I need by end-of-day Wednesday (5/23):
- Owners: please claim the opps assigned to you in the attached CSV.
- For each claimed opp, update SFDC with either: confirmed close date + evidence link OR set to "At Risk" and add a short note.
- If you cannot move a close date, mark the opp "Stalled - needs finance review" so we can exclude from committed revenue.

Priority buckets (how to triage):
1) Confirmed pipeline (active discussions, legal/proc in progress) — update close date and push evidence link.
2) Probable but needs date reconfirmation — set expected quarter and a next-step (call/PO request).
3) Zombie / no response >60 days — claim & archive or convert to nurture.

Attachments: brightline-stale-opps-extract-20280521.csv (columns: opportunity_id, owner, stage, last_activity, close_date, amount)
Related links: HubSpot deal list (HubSpot:12547) and a shared Drive folder for evidence (Drive link below).

Why this matters: finance needs an accurate commit list for the month-close review. If we leave stale opps as "Commit", we risk overstating ARR and triggering a manual audit.

If you have any blockers (legal, procurement gating, or a pending credits ask), reply here and I will escalate to finance/ops.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFGH_example
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/objects/deals/12547

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF Stage Stewardship: action checklist for stale opportunities

Thanks Marcus — I pulled the extract. Claiming 3 opps (OPP-8721, OPP-8734, OPP-8790).

Quick notes: OPP-8734 is mid-contract-negotiation but legal asked for a change to the subscription term; I expect a new close-date in the next 7–10 days. Can we allow an extra week for that one before we move it to "Stalled"? If finance needs hard proof now, I can add a note and the latest redline.

I updated OPP-8721 with the evidence link (Drive/contract-drafts/8734) and added the expected close of 2028-06-15.

- Rishi
Sr. Account Executive

Looping in a few data points from finance so everyone has the context.

Finance note: anything left as "Commit" without evidence will be flagged for removal from the committed forecast on Friday (5/24). If an opp is moving from Commit -> At Risk, finance needs a 1-line reason in the SFDC notes (e.g., "Legal redlines pending: awaiting signature") and an estimate if we expect conversion within the quarter.

Actionable items I completed:
- Uploaded signed SOW for OPP-8721 to Drive (Drive/confirmed/OPP-8721-signed.pdf).
- Marked OPP-8805 as "Stalled - needs finance review" (owner: unassigned) and added "no response to pricing since 3/1".
- Added a finance tag to OPP-8790 so it is excluded from month-close commit exports until you confirm.

Rishi — thanks for the heads-up on OPP-8734. Give legal the 7–10 days; if there is no signature by 5/30 I will remove it from commit and notify the forecast owner.

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick responses — short recap and next steps: 

1) Rishi: noted your claims and the expected 2028-06-15 close on OPP-8721 (evidence uploaded). Keep me posted if legal changes the timeline; Monica will remove from commit after 5/30 if unsigned.
2) Monica: thanks for the finance guidance and evidence uploads. Please run the commit export on Friday morning and share the results to this thread so I can validate.
3) Neha: please pick up any unclaimed opps in the extract and assign an owner or mark for archive. If you think an opp should move to nurture instead of archive, add a one-line rationale.

I will follow up Friday EOD with a one-page snapshot for leadership if there are material changes to committed revenue. If anyone needs me to escalate a procurement blocker for Brightline, ping me directly.

Thanks —
Marcus
